title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - VulnerableRoadUser
description: Archetype of vulnerable road users: non-motorized road users as well as users of VRU vehicles (L-class vehicles, e.g. mopeds or motorcycles) participating in road traffic (s4auto:VulnerableRoadUser, subclass of s4auto:TrafficParticipant).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VulnerableRoadUser'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. WGS84 position, modeling s4auto:Position / s4auto:GeoPosition.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

heading.description: Property. Orientation of the horizontal velocity vector (s4auto:Heading), in degrees.

speed.description: Property. Magnitude of the velocity vector (s4auto:Velocity3d), in m/s.

vruSubProfile.description: Property. Narrower VRU sub-profile, where applicable (s4auto:VulnerableRoadUser_<Profile>_*).

trajectoryInterceptionProbability.description: Property. Probability (%) that the observer's trajectory intercepts with the trajectory of this VRU (s4auto:TrajectoryInterceptionProbability).

vruDeviceUsage.description: Property. Usage condition of the VRU's device (s4auto:VruDeviceUsage).

vruEnvironment.description: Property. Environment condition the VRU is in (s4auto:VruEnvironment).

vruSpecificExteriorLights.description: Property. Status of the VRU's exterior light switches (s4auto:VruSpecificExteriorLights).

vruMovementControl.description: Property. Status of the human control a VRU is exerting over their VRU vehicle (s4auto:VruMovementControl).

vruSizeClass.description: Property. Approximate size class of the VRU, including any VRU vehicle used (s4auto:VruSizeClass).

cluster.description: Relationship. The VRUCluster this VRU is currently a member of, if any.
